name: Cloudflare peer routing
description: Plan explicit peer-ID DNS inclusion and exclusion while preserving unmanaged records. Execution and origin verification are host responsibilities.

wildcardJustification.detail: Authenticated operator configuration and a complete, fresh verified discovery/origin and DNS snapshot. Routing control metadata, never persisted as an SDS observation.

inputPorts.description: Authenticated operator configuration and a complete, fresh verified discovery/origin and DNS snapshot.

wildcardJustification.detail: Deterministic DNS actions and per-peer status; applied is always false until the host verifies execution. Routing control metadata, never persisted as an SDS observation.

outputPorts.description: Deterministic DNS actions and per-peer status; applied is always false until the host verifies execution.

sequentialJustification.detail: Bounded deterministic DNS comparison and identity encoding; no workers or network access inside this planning method.
